questions.title: Method with Parameters
questions.description: Write a Java program with a method called 'greet' that takes a name as a parameter and prints a greeting message. Call the method from main with the name 'Alice'.
hints: Define: public static void greet(String name)

questions.title: Return Value Method
questions.description: Write a Java program with a method called 'square' that takes an integer and returns its square. Use the method to calculate and print the square of 8.
hints: Return type should be int, not void
Store returned value in a variable

questions.title: Method Overloading
questions.description: Write a Java program that demonstrates method overloading. Create three methods named 'add': one that adds two integers, one that adds three integers, and one that adds two doubles. Test all three versions.

examples.output:
Sum of 5 and 3: 8
Sum of 2, 4, 6: 12
Sum of 2.5 and 3.5: 6.0

hints: add(int a, int b), add(int a, int b, int c)
questions.expectedOutput:
Sum of 5 and 3: 8
Sum of 2, 4, 6: 12
Sum of 2.5 and 3.5: 6.0

questions.title: Recursive Fibonacci
questions.description: Write a Java program with a recursive method to calculate the nth Fibonacci number. Calculate and print the 10th Fibonacci number. Fibonacci: F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2).
constraints: Handle base cases F(0) and F(1)
hints: Base case: if n <= 1, return n

questions.title: Power Calculator
questions.description: Write a Java program with a recursive method called 'power' that calculates base^exponent. Calculate 2^8 using this method. Do not use Math.pow().
